aboutText: With over 35 years of experience, Mcsweeney Electrical has been proudly servicing the Alphington community and surrounding inner Melbourne suburbs including Camberwell, Richmond, Hawthorn, Kew, and Preston. We are a fully Australian-owned electrical business committed to delivering safe, reliable, and high-quality electrical solutions for homes and businesses alike. Whether you need routine maintenance or an emergency callout, our licensed electricians have the expertise to get the job done right the first time.
servicesText: From Alphington homes to commercial premises across Melbourne, Mcsweeney Electrical delivers comprehensive electrical solutions backed by 35 years of hands-on industry experience and a reputation for quality workmanship.

services.title: Residential Electrical
services.desc: Complete home electrical services for Alphington and inner Melbourne, from wiring and rewiring to safety inspections and upgrades.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial
services.desc: Tailored electrical installations and maintenance for offices, retail spaces, warehouses, and industrial facilities across Melbourne.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Round-the-clock emergency electrician service for urgent faults, power outages, and safety hazards in your home or business.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: Indoor, outdoor, and LED lighting design and installation to enhance your property's comfort, security, and energy efficiency.

services.title: Safety & Compliance
services.desc: Thorough electrical safety testing, compliance certificates, and pre-sale inspections to keep your property safe and fully compliant.
